description: Implement the StepProcessingUnit[TInput,TOutput] generic callable contract and SPUExecutionResult[TOutput] result aggregate. The SPU performs one assigned processing responsibility inside its owning Step, returns a structured result (processingArtifact, spuErrorOccurrences, validatorResult), registers its own SPUErrorTypeDefinition instances, and creates SPUError occurrences. It must NOT assemble StepExecutionResult or decide Step flow transitions.
acceptanceCriteria: SPU execute(input: TInput) -> SPUExecutionResult[TOutput] signature implemented
SPUExecutionResult carries processingArtifact, spuErrorOccurrences, validatorResult as independently optional elements
SPU defines and registers its own SPUErrorTypeDefinition instances via Pipeline-assigned registry
SPU creates SPUError occurrences for its own processing errors
No reverse package dependency from SPU to Step
Prefect State never substitutes for SPUExecutionResult
definitionOfDone: Unit tests cover execute success, error occurrence creation, result optionality
Architecture test enforces SPU does not import Step Composition
Integration test confirms SPUExecutionResult distinct from StepExecutionResult
testStrategy: Unit tests for SPU contract; architecture tests for dependency direction; integration test through Step Composition
